notes.traffic: Door-counter entries. Offline hours are masked, then filled from the same zone, weekday and hour; partial hours are scaled to 60 minutes.
notes.city: LVCVA city visitation and NOAA weather are context only; they are not inputs to any model.
notes.uplift: Event days vs same-weekday non-event days within 28 days; ratio of means, bootstrap 90% interval.
